meta.title: About us
meta.description: Discover Trustech's purpose, values and seven schools in Douala, Cameroon.

about.title: About Trustech
about.subtitle: Who we are and what we stand for.
about.heroTitle: Knowledge with purpose. People with possibility.
about.heroIntro: Trustech is a bilingual university institute in Douala, bringing together seven schools and a shared commitment to learning that reaches beyond the classroom.
about.historyBody: TRUSTECH UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF BUSINESS MANAGEMENT AND BIOMEDICAL SCIENCES is based in Douala, Cameroon. Our bilingual academic community spans seven schools across professional, scientific, creative and technical fields.
about.identityBody: We connect study with practical capability, helping learners explore their strengths and prepare to contribute in the fields they choose.
about.purposeIntro: Our mission and vision keep the focus on students, useful knowledge and the communities they will serve.
about.missionBody: To help students develop the knowledge, practical capability and professional confidence to contribute meaningfully across the fields they choose.
about.visionBody: To be a trusted higher-education community known for practical learning, clear student support and strong links to professional opportunity.
about.valuesBody: Student focus, integrity, practical learning and respect for bilingual communities guide the way we teach and support one another.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.body: We value honest work, responsible decisions and trust in every relationship.

practice.title: Practical learning
practice.body: We connect ideas to application and encourage confidence through doing.

people.title: People first
people.body: We keep students, educators and the communities around us at the centre.

possibility.title: Room to grow
possibility.body: We welcome curiosity, different perspectives and the ambition to keep improving.

about.schoolsIntro: Discover the disciplines that make up Trustech and find the direction that speaks to you.
about.finalTitle: A conversation can open a path.
about.finalBody: Ask our team about academic options, admissions or current institutional information.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How Trustech handles information shared through its website and admissions services.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle information shared through Trustech digital services.

purpose.title: Information we collect
purpose.body: We collect the information you choose to provide through contact and admissions services, including contact details, academic information and supporting documents where an application requires them.

commitment.title: How we use it
commitment.body: Information is used to respond to enquiries, process applications, provide student services and meet institutional record-keeping obligations. We do not use it for unrelated purposes.

yourRole.title: How we protect it
yourRole.body: Access is limited to authorised staff and service providers who need the information to deliver the relevant service. We use role-based access, secure connections and operational controls to protect records.

contact.title: Your choices
contact.body: You may ask about the personal information held about you, request corrections, or raise a privacy concern through our contact page. Some records may need to be retained where required for an active application or institutional obligation.

privacy.reviewNote: This policy will be reviewed as Trustech services and legal obligations develop. For a privacy request,

meta.description: Terms that apply to use of the Trustech website and digital services.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.subtitle: The basic terms for using Trustech digital services.

purpose.title: Using this website
purpose.body: You may use this website to learn about Trustech, explore programmes and access available digital services for lawful, personal or institutional purposes.

commitment.title: Accurate information
commitment.body: When you submit an enquiry or application, you are responsible for providing information that is complete and accurate. Trustech may contact you to clarify or verify what you provide.

yourRole.title: Responsible access
yourRole.body: Do not attempt to disrupt the website, gain unauthorised access, submit misleading content, or use another person’s account or personal information without permission.

contact.title: Changes and questions
contact.body: Trustech may update these terms as its services develop. If you have a question about using the site or a digital service, please contact the institution before proceeding.

terms.reviewNote: These terms will be maintained alongside the release of new services. For a question about them,

meta.title: Accessibility
meta.description: Trustech’s commitment to accessible digital services.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.subtitle: Our commitment to making Trustech digital services usable by more people.

purpose.title: Our commitment
purpose.body: We aim to make the website and future student services usable with keyboards, screen readers, clear content structure and responsive layouts across common devices.

commitment.title: How we design
commitment.body: We use semantic page structure, visible keyboard focus, readable text, language-aware pages and colour choices that support clear contrast. We test public pages on mobile as well as desktop.

yourRole.title: Known limits
yourRole.body: Some content and third-party services may not yet meet every accessibility need. We prioritise improvements that affect access to admissions, student information and essential services.

contact.title: Report a barrier
contact.body: If a feature is difficult to use, tell us what you were trying to do, the device or assistive technology you used, and the page involved. We will use that feedback to improve the service.
